-- ⚠️ 本机无 MySQL 凭证, 未实跑; expected_output 只给出语法结构要点与结果集表头形态
-- 参数模式: IN 只读传入 / OUT 入口置 NULL 由过程写回 / INOUT 读初值并写回
DELIMITER $$                                   -- 客户端指令: 结束符临时改为 $$
CREATE PROCEDURE p_discount(
    IN    p_amount  DECIMAL(10,2),
    IN    p_rate    DECIMAL(5,4),
    OUT   p_final   DECIMAL(10,2),
    INOUT p_counter INT
)
BEGIN
    SET p_final   = p_amount * (1 - p_rate);   -- OUT: 写回
    SET p_counter = p_counter + 1;             -- INOUT: 读初值后写回
END$$
DELIMITER ;                                    -- 恢复默认结束符

-- 调用: OUT/INOUT 的实参必须是用户变量
SET @cnt = 5;
CALL p_discount(100.00, 0.1500, @final, @cnt);
SELECT @final AS final_amount, @cnt AS counter_value;
